business.title: Paramount Skydance has completed its $111B merger with Warner Bros. Discovery
business.titleZh: Paramount Skydance完成与Warner Bros. Discovery的111B合并
business.summaryZh: Paramount Skydance已完成与Warner Bros. Discovery的1110亿美元合并，新公司命名为Skydance。合并过程因多州诉讼而延迟，但最终获得法院批准。新公司整合了两家大型电影制片厂、流媒体服务、新闻机构及体育赛事版权。
business.overviewZh: Paramount Skydance已完成与Warner Bros. Discovery的1110亿美元合并，新公司命名为Skydance。合并过程因多州诉讼而延迟，但最终获得法院批准。新公司整合了两家大型电影制片厂、流媒体服务、新闻机构及体育赛事版权。
facts: Paramount Skydance以1110亿美元完成与Warner Bros. Discovery的合并
合并后新公司名称为Skydance，源自Paramount此前收购的同名公司
美国最高法院大法官Elena Kagan驳回了阻止合并的最后努力
business.impact: 合并后的新实体Skydance成为拥有庞大媒体资产的巨头，可能显著减少市场竞争。美国法官曾裁定合并可能大幅减少竞争并违反反垄断法。诉讼的和解为合并扫清了最后障碍。
evidence: Paramount Skydance completed its $111 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery today, after a last-ditch effort to block the deal was rejected by Supreme Court Justice Elena Kagan.
The post-merger company is called Skydance, taking the name of a firm that Paramount bought in a separate deal last year.
In July, US District Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín in the Northern District of California ruled that the combination would likely reduce competition substantially and violate antitrust laws.
California settled the lawsuit last month, and the other states involved went along with the compromise.

attribution.claim: 合并后公司包含Paramount+和HBO Max、CBS、CNN、体育赛事版权等广泛业务

items.titleZh: Paramount Skydance完成与Warner Bros. Discovery的111B合并
items.summaryZh: Paramount Skydance已完成与Warner Bros. Discovery的1110亿美元合并，新公司命名为Skydance。合并过程因多州诉讼而延迟，但最终获得法院批准。新公司整合了两家大型电影制片厂、流媒体服务、新闻机构及体育赛事版权。

facts: Paramount Skydance以1110亿美元完成与Warner Bros. Discovery的合并
合并后新公司名称为Skydance，源自Paramount此前收购的同名公司
美国最高法院大法官Elena Kagan驳回了阻止合并的最后努力
items.impact: 合并后的新实体Skydance成为拥有庞大媒体资产的巨头，可能显著减少市场竞争。美国法官曾裁定合并可能大幅减少竞争并违反反垄断法。诉讼的和解为合并扫清了最后障碍。
evidence: Paramount Skydance completed its $111 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery today, after a last-ditch effort to block the deal was rejected by Supreme Court Justice Elena Kagan.
The post-merger company is called Skydance, taking the name of a firm that Paramount bought in a separate deal last year.
In July, US District Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín in the Northern District of California ruled that the combination would likely reduce competition substantially and violate antitrust laws.
California settled the lawsuit last month, and the other states involved went along with the compromise.
